papers.title: Quantum Optimal Transport for Tensor Field Processing
papers.source_facts: Selected sections1.3/2.1/3.1-3.3/4: PSD tensor measures; KL direction and singular-support conventions; unbalanced matrix marginals; commuting reduction and log-Euclidean single-pair case; entropic primal/dual; scalar/isotropic contraction versus higher-dimensional observations; trace-only extension and meaning of quantum.
papers.limits: Real symmetric source domain; complex-Hermitian transfer requires explicit extension. The first-argument S++ indicator on PDFp5 is distinguished from the usual closed-PSD relative-entropy convention. No general8D convergence proof, code inspection, barycenter proof or experiment replication.
papers.supplements: Included selected appendix pages only; no separately requested supplement

papers.title: Ideal Abstractions for Decision-Focused Learning
papers.source_facts: Selected sections2/3/4.1-4.3 and appendixA: externally specified action/outcome loss; Bayes H-entropy; outcome-simplex folding; worst-case set extension and monotonicity proof; p-dependent weighted extension; objective variants and selected concavity argument.
papers.limits: Not a token-attention theorem or a fixed-loss Macro-F1 guarantee. No code inspection, full empirical audit or claimed complexity theorem. Internal camera-ready header is not an independently verified proceedings copy; supplementary experiment text only partly read.
papers.supplements: Included selected appendix pages only; no separately requested supplement
